column8: ["The teal housing has weight, but its cloudy, uniform texture reads as weathered metal rather than glazed ceramic; give the glaze cleaner depth and reserve abrasion for contact edges.","Brass fittings blur into brown grooves, and the seat rims lack a distinct matte rubber surface; sharpen the material changes where these parts meet.","Repeated chevron panels feel stamped and diagrammatic; give the fittings more purposeful, individually resolved shapes.","Pale upper-left bevels and dark lower-right edges imply directional illumination; model the rounded surfaces with symmetric tonal bands."]
